name: Major General Shakil Ahmed
contribution: Led BDR at Pilkhana and was among the first senior officers killed during the mutiny.
impact: His killing became the central symbol of the massacre and command collapse.
highlight: Major General Shakil Ahmed was the BDR director general killed at Pilkhana on 25 February 2009.
seoTitle: Major General Shakil Ahmed: BDR Chief at Pilkhana
seoDescription: A concise profile of Major General Shakil Ahmed and his death during the 2009 Pilkhana massacre.
shortAnswer: Major General Shakil Ahmed was the BDR director general killed during the 2009 Pilkhana massacre.
